A parking permit ($6 per vehicle via Recreation.gov) is required through October 1, 2026; permits have been available seven days a week since May 2026. Fossil Springs Trail parking is booked on Recreation.gov under the Bob Bear Trailhead listing. Permit holders must reach the FR 708/SR 260 junction by 2pm, and gates to the Dixon Lewis, Irving/Flume, Tonto Bench, Fossil Creek Bridge, and Homestead lots close at 3pm; camping remains prohibited. A Flood Watch covering Yavapai County Mountains and Northern Gila County, issued by NWS Flagstaff, is active today through early Sunday morning (5am MST) for possible flash flooding; this trail crosses Fossil Creek in a canyon, so avoid hiking during and after storms. Hike early morning and carry extra water. Source: Coconino National Forest; Recreation.gov; National Weather Service.
